name: ☠️ Horror Phonk Troll Tower
desc:
💀 Welcome to HORROR Troll Tower… if you dare. 💀 

😱 Can you climb your way to safety, or will the killer worms lurking in the shadows drag you screaming into the depths?
🪱 Malicious creatures stalk every step — some taunt, some chase… and some wait for the perfect moment to strike.
😈 Will you survive the terror, or become the next victim twisted into their feeding grounds?

🩸 Join our group for an exclusive Blood 67 Glove:
👉 Troll Tower Experiment: https://www.roblox.com/communities/1113339041

🫥 Thanks for playing — but keep your eyes open…
The worms don’t like when you stop moving.

Inspired by Slap Tower and other chaotic slap games.
